text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An unthinkable upset!!
Mr. C.B. falls at Nakayama—!!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! Are you kidding me?!
Did my Triple Crown dream just end out of nowhere!?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No way……
I wanted to see CB win……――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Ace-chan, that was so close...
Still, you were amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You really gave it your all out there...!
Losing is a bummer, but—
you were super cool!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... damn it...—
I can't... catch my breath... and yet...—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah.
Honestly, it's really frustrating. But—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Which is precisely why it's so thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...She's already carrying herself
with so much confidence...!)

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...Even after finishing the run, her depth remains unfathomable.
...So this is Mr. C.B....—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Game one of the best-of-three... looks like we both missed out.
Still, today's race was super thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the Japanese Derby.
—Because next time, I'm gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (What a... massive back...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! Stop shaking...!!

"...And so, the Satsuki Sho spread through the news
as Mr. C.B.'s narrow defeat—"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—With the Satsuki Sho behind us,
just what kind of race will
the upcoming Japanese Derby turn out to be?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"C.B. remains the undisputed favorite.
After all, even with the track conditions being disadvantageous for a chaser like her during the Satsuki Sho, she pulled through."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, such a development was perhaps unavoidable.
I'm certain she will demonstrate her true capabilities at the Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "It'll certainly be worth watching to see who steps up to challenge Mr. C.B."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""In my view, Sheena Frejus is a strong contender.
She hails from a lineage of Umamusume with proven success over long distances, inheriting both the talent and technique.""

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "‘As the distance increases from the Derby to the Kikuka Sho, her stability should only grow. The one who will truly become CB's rival is likely her—’"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Haha. You can't even remember my name.
Well, I guess that's obvious...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...It's so frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not just that I lost,
more than that, it's about myself...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The thought that I might not be able to beat CB... is making me tremble...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "After crossing the finish line at the Satsuki Sho, more than just frustration, I could tell CB was burning with passion for the Derby...!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"While I was desperately catching my breath,
she was already looking at what lies beyond..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her look so huge like that……
For the first time ever, I actually felt scared.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: And that... is so frustrating... dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list: Even if you're scared, you haven't given up. Am I right?
Even if you're scared, you haven't given up. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.text: No matter how formidable Mr. C.B. was, the fact remains that Katsuragi Ace boldly challenged her, and is ready to challenge her again next time.
If Mr. C.B. gets stronger, then Katsuragi Ace just has to get stronger too.

Mr. C.B.'s growth is certainly remarkable, but Katsuragi Ace's
rate of growth leading up to the Satsuki Sho
was surely even faster...!

As long as Katsuragi Ace's spirit remains unbroken,
there is always a chance for victory...!

"I believe in that――
even more than Katsuragi Ace does……!!"
choice_data_list: So let's win the Japan Derby!!

text_block_list.text: —Standing in front of Katsuragi Ace, I clenched my fist tightly, just like she did.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
you're seriously such an idiot sometimes...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that side of you
is super cool, and you're so reliable...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Thanks to that, I can act like a total fool and fight with all I've got...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trembling or scared, it doesn't matter!
All I gotta do is push past every bit of it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's—what an "ace" is all about!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right!! Aiming for the Japanese Derby, let's do this, let's do thiiis!!!

Putting our arms around each other's shoulders, we raised our fists to the sky.
With our spirits fired up...
we march forward to the next decisive battle, the Japanese Derby!
